verdict.rationale: Evidence shows RTX 5080 marketing around Tensor Cores and generic 'AI PC' inference backends (Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch) and CUDA Toolkit dev tools, but there is no documented mention of low-precision FP8/FP4 support specifics or dedicated serving-stack integration (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, llama.cpp); ROCm is AMD-specific and not applicable to this NVIDIA part. missing for 10: explicit FP8/FP4 precision documentation, TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support details, benchmarks or independent corroboration of inference performance.
